stories.text: 🔮 PROJECTION FLIP: The Mahomies is now projected to beat Gibb it to Me Baby.
🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: The Mahomies just moved above the projected league median.
🪦 The eulogy is in: In My Fantasy Era gets its send-off (15.39 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
⚡ MOMENTUM SHIFT: The Mahomies' win odds against Gibb it to Me Baby jumped from 31% to 51% in the last 1058 minutes.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Ruffing the Passer vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Ruffing the Passer 44% / 21%, Mr. Action Jackson 88% / 68%.
🧟 LINEUP ALERT: Tyler Loop is on injured reserve, and yet there he is in Gibb it to Me Baby's starting lineup. You have until Thursday 8:15 PM.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 46% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 33%).
📈 LINE MOVE: JAX @ BAL: BAL −4.5 at open, JAX −10 now. 10 league starters in it, led by B. Tuten (Kyle Tucker).
🥶 The Mahomies has dropped 5 straight. Can they snap it against Gibb it to Me Baby?
🧊 THIN ICE: Ruffing the Passer has no healthy backup RB behind Jacobs and Hubbard. One more injury and there's a hole in the lineup.
📈 TRENDING: Every other league is scrambling for Devin Singletary (RB, NYG). Ours has him sitting on waivers.
🕰️ Hindsight swap: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 11% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted The Mahomies after the favorite flipped 5 times.
